name: jury-progress
description: Shows the live ai-jury runs inside Claude Code: one line per run above the prompt, each seat's state, and a /jury-progress pane, read from the metadata-only events ai-jury writes to $JURY_EVENTS_DIR. Read-only; it never runs jury.

capture.title: Capture this session's jury runs
capture.description: When the session has no JURY_EVENTS_DIR, set one (ai-jury's cache directory, /events) so every jury this session starts writes its progress there. Off: only a JURY_EVENTS_DIR you set yourself is read.

poll_seconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often to read the events while a run is live. With no live run it reads five times less often.

band_rows.title: Runs above the prompt
band_rows.description: How many runs the band shows before '+N more'.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Show a toast when a run ends (its verdict and findings) or stops without finishing.
